about_short_description.short_description: Eden Care Medical is a mobile application that provides medical and health insurance as well as financial services.

product.name: Group Health Insurance
product.description: Customizable employer-sponsored health insurance plans for SMEs and corporations, with digital enrollment, claims, provider access, and coverage administration.

product.name: ProActiv Health & Wellness
product.description: A digital health and wellness program that supports preventive care, mental and physical wellbeing, health education, coaching, testing, and rewards for healthy activities.

product.name: Ucare Insurance
product.description: An Eden Care insurance product listed alongside its health insurance and wellness offerings; the available source does not specify its coverage scope or target customer.

product.name: Digital Healthcare Administration Platform
product.description: A mobile and online platform for digital enrollment, policy access, provider search, appointment scheduling, claims submission, billing, and health records management.

identifier.value: Healthcare Provider and Distribution Partner Services

product.name: Healthcare Provider and Distribution Partner Services
product.description: Operational services for clinical providers, agents, and brokers, including online portals, quote generation, billing administration, scheduled payments, and support.
